about: Persistent photo-to-model findings. Open findings are comparison work, not permission to move geometry. Never delete history or close from a software pass. See docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md.

discrepancies.description: Compare the current water/construction/deck edges separately, including the squared deck tongue east of the steps. The approved loop PRD records this difference; measure the current model before correcting it.
discrepancies.resolution: 15 Nov: both deck tongues corrected as a measured change (data/pool_ring_corrections.json): changed edges 0.14 m rms on 39 picks and 0.18 m rms on 9 held-out picks through IMG_2204-2206, reviewed and approved with notes by a second agent (data/placement_reviews.json measuredApprovals measured-north-pool-ring-tongues; docs/reviews/pool-deck-outline/REVIEW.md).

discrepancies.description: Inventory and compare the white pool-side box, parasols, plants and trees against the current Inspect Details render. Record individual missing or misplaced items before building; split this finding by feature as needed.
Resolve the northwest terrace/stair position and visible floor limits. Existing records flag uncertain concealed ends and a possible eastward offset; do not treat these as a measured correction.
Keep concealed patio ground edges and Isabel-side access widths unresolved until ground corners can be identified independently. This does not block visible pool, deck or facade corrections.

Registry part3's notch corner (-179.4, 33.7) projects about 40 px (0.4-0.5 m at 12 m) east of the near block's edge in IMG_2206 through the solved station camera, and the block's top reads about 1 m higher in the photo than the two-storey model. One camera only: not a measured correction until a second solved camera or the lidar confirms it.

IMG_2206 and IMG_2208 show white patio walls about 1.8 m high with curved cappings and brown plank doors south of the west path; the model has 1 m generated garden walls there, in the right place but without height, cappings or doors. Door feet are hidden by planting.

The south-west deck tongue's north edge has a recess about 0.5-0.6 m wide where the ladder stands (IMG_2205 x 48-100, IMG_2206 x 1475-1510); the corrected ring runs straight across it. Two held-out picks in the ring measurement were interpolated across it (without them held-out is 0.17 m rms, n=7).

The pool ladders render as small arcs barely above the coping; IMG_2204 and IMG_2205 show tall goose-neck stainless rails anchored on the deck. Positions now match the photos; the fitting's size or height (pool_ladder in src/slice.ts and src/pool-kit.ts) does not.

The pump box (o4) is now placed and turned as photographed, but the model draws louvres on all four sides where IMG_2204 and IMG_2205 show them on the front-right face only, and it is 1.1 m long against about 1.2 m. The shower post beside it is not modelled.

Near the north row's house fronts the roof station cannot fix depth: furniture, door feet and awning attachments cast 1-3 m from the registry fronts (some behind them), and the two station cameras differ by 0.6-1.6 m in depth at the patio front. The laser survey's roof fit moves the resort's footprints about 1.5 m north, but barely improves. The re-traced north patios, path and lawn edge use IMG_2205; furniture and awnings are placed relative to the registry fronts. A second camera station (ground level, from the lawn) would allow a measured correction of the patio front and test the registry fronts.

IMG_2199 shows the patio pergola's beam on the garden wall starting at the closed door's raised coping, which puts the beam end at or just south of the aerial-inferred dividing wall; the pergola is drawn against the north side of that wall. Which patio the pergola belongs to, and whether the divider meets the garden wall where inferred, needs a view from inside the patios.

On the north side of Calle Jorge the Esri and Google aerials show a white patio wall square to the lane at about 111.1 m, from the house corner of 6364401UF1366S_part2 to the planters, and the first brick entrance about 2 m west of it. The model's planter entrances (data/jorge_lane.json boundary gaps 112.4-113.5 and 114.7-115.8 m, with their number niches) were placed from photo pins (±2-5 m), and the garden end placed the same way proved 4 m too far east. Built as they are, a wall at 111.1 m would stand between the first entrance and the patio IMG_2230 shows it leading into, so that wall is left out (independent review, docs/reviews/lane-walls/). Needs the planter entrances re-placed against the aerial or a square-on photo (photo request jorge-east-square-on); walls at 117.5 and 124.5 m should be re-checked against them then.

The laser survey (PNOA-LiDAR 2020-21, 1 m ground model, sampled every 0.5 m along the Cervantes centreline) has the lane level at +0.53 m from 47.5 m along it eastwards and at +1.13-1.17 m from 42.5 m westwards: the 0.6 m drop is centred about 45 m along the lane. The photo-placed flight and ramp (data/cervantes_elena_steps.json, cervantes-elena-ramp) run from the drain at 49.1 m to 46.1 m, centred about 47.6 m, so the survey puts the drop about 2 m further west; the model is up to about 0.4 m above the survey at 46-47 m (independent review of 17 November 2026). A 1 m ground model widens a 3 m ramp, and the camera pins near the junction are 1.5-4.7 m, so this alone does not justify moving the reviewed flight, garden door, beds and lawns that hang off the drain. Settle it before detail goes on the junction with a solved camera: IMG_2286 has the drain, the tile grid and the door (scripts/photo_pose.py), with IMG_2464 or IMG_2328 as the second view.

The lane-edge 'patio walls' of data/cervantes_patio_walls.json are 0.65 m high on both sides from the Dalí exit to east of Elena. In the November photos (IMG_2264, IMG_2467, IMG_2468, IMG_2274) the bed edges on the north side are low rounded kerbs of about 0.15-0.2 m with the planting standing over them, and on the south side the houses and garden walls come down to the lane. 17 November 2026: cervantes-patio-north-1 lowered to 0.15 m with the new at-grade bed behind it (independent review); the other four (south-1, south-2, south-3, north-east) are still 0.65 m.
